caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular dark brown wooden panel with cropped corners, carved with intricate designs. At the center, there is an oval-shaped medallion bordered with a twisted rope pattern and decorated with carved leaves. Inside the medallion, a human figure wearing a short tunic stands on the right side, holding up a sheaf of wheat in one hand and holding a sickle in the other hand. To the left and right of the figure, within the medallion, are two standing bundles of wheat. At the left of the figure, there is also a carved flower with five petals. The background of the panel is uniformly dark, and the carved elements stand out due to the highlights and shadows created by the engraving. The panel itself rests on a plain, light-colored background.
title: Cake Board
